cases.translation: He called me into his office, cleared the statements and bills off the solitary chair beside his roll-top desk, and without looking up at me, he said, "I've been meaning to talk to you. cases.translation: "And I treated you like my own son who gave up his life for his country. And when Herman died—how old were you? seventeen? more like a six-year-old boy—I swore to myself ... When they committed you to that Warren place, I told them how you would work for me, and I would take care of you. You didn't spend even one night in that place.
